body: EQT entered into a merger agreement to acquire Range Resources in an all-stock transaction. Range shareholders will receive 0.987 EQT shares for each Range share, with cash paid in lieu of fractional shares; existing EQT shareholders and Range stockholders are expected to own approximately 73% and 27% of the combined company, respectively.
